name: com.maicon.scene-analyzer
description: Real-time Unity scene analysis, validation, and authoring exposed to AI agents over MCP. Includes an embedded chat panel (Coder Chat) that talks to a D:\MCP coder runtime via SSE so the dev never leaves Unity. ~80 tools across read, analyze, discover, create, modify, animation, audio, physics, post-fx, render settings, screenshots, plus apply_changeset for atomic batch authoring (single Undo group + asset Undo + delete-on-revert).
